    n_components: int,
    random_state: int = 0,

    """Return leading spectral coordinates for a cell-by-feature count matrix."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not np.isfinite(counts).all():
        raise ValueError("counts contains nonfinite values")
    if (counts < 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts contains negative values")
    row_sums = counts.sum(axis=1)
    if (row_sums == 0).any():
        raise ValueError("counts has all-zero cell rows")
    if n_components < 1 or n_components >= counts.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError("n_components must be 1 <= n_components < n_cells")

    # Matrix-free spectral embedding via SVD on row-normalized count matrix
    scaling = 1.0 / np.sqrt(row_sums)
    X = counts * scaling[:, np.newaxis]

    U, s, Vt = svd(X, full_matrices=False)

    # Ensure we have enough singular values
    min_dim = min(X.shape)
    if n_components > min_dim:
        raise ValueError(f"n_components {n_components} exceeds available dimensions {min_dim}")

    eigenvalues = s[:n_components] ** 2
